div.h2: Tools I built to skip the boring bits.

div.p: A GUI tool that pushes test results to Jira through its REST API and to Confluence by scraping it — no API existed — so nothing is entered twice.
Reads DLT logs and flags blocker and minor issues automatically. Adopted and now maintained by the defect-triaging team.
Detects, downloads and flashes daily builds with checksum validation, ignition retries and Teams alerts — the lunch-hour release window no longer needs a human watching it.
Parallelized file handling with Python multiprocessing and ran log, report and media pipelines side by side.
